proposed_widenings.name: succeed_on_save
proposed_widenings.justification: The ring's core mechanic converts a failed saving throw into a success after the roll is resolved. No existing EffectAtom models a post-roll failure override. modify_roll_advantage applies before rolling; modify_roll_numeric adds a delta (not guaranteed success); neither can represent 'you succeed instead'. This is a distinct post-resolution override atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.

proposed_widenings.name: reaction trigger condition on ActivatedAbilityMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Spell reactions carry a ReactionTrigger on CastingTime (hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_named_spell, creature_casts_spell). Non-spell activations using activationCost { kind: 'reaction' } have no equivalent field to constrain when the reaction may fire. The Ring of Evasion's reaction is only legal when the wearer fails a Dexterity saving throw — this condition is currently not expressible on ActivatedAbilityMechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.

notes: The charge pool (3 charges, dawn reset with 1d3) and reaction activation cost both fit the current surface cleanly — RestResetCadence.dawn with a DiceAmount regain and ClassFeatureActivationCost.reaction are already modeled. The blocking gaps are (1) no effect atom for post-roll save-failure override and (2) no trigger condition on non-spell reaction activations. Without atom (1) there is no honest EffectAtom to put in a direct phase; coercing this to modify_roll_advantage or any existing atom would produce a false trace.
